spans.s: चूडा f. 1. The hair on the forehead, a single lock on the crown of the head, R.xviii.51; 2. the ceremony of tonsure; 3. the crest of a cock or peacock; 4. head, top, summit; 5. a room on the top of a house; 6. a well; 7. an ornament worn on the wrist.
